title: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of Explainability in Media Bias Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating BERT and RoBERTa classifiers on the BABE (Bias Annotations By Experts) dataset, which contains news sentences from U.S. outlets spanning left, center, and right political leanings. The methodology assesses classification performance, token-level explanation plausibility (comparing attention attribution scores against expert-annotated rationales), and mechanistic faithfulness (using activation patching and counterfactual masking of biased keywords to discover computational circuits).
